# Alien

Alien is a dark theme built on deep blacks with a phosphor-green glow on headings and links, in a look its description traces to the Nostromo. Code colours follow a terminal palette, with acid-lime strings and amber numbers, and blockquotes glow as well. Red alert is reserved for errors and unresolved links, and a softened light mode is included.

![Alien screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jabaho9523/AlienTheme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Alien"
    author: "jabaho9523"
    repo:   "jabaho9523/AlienTheme"
    slug:   "alien"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/alien"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jabaho9523/AlienTheme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jabaho9523/AlienTheme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Nostromo-inspired dark theme with deep-space blacks, phosphor-green glow on headings and links, terminal-style code colors (acid-lime strings, amber numbers) and glowing blockquotes. Reserve red-alert for errors and unresolved links and include a softened light mode."
}
```
